text: If I add Rs 3,000 to wallet using a credit card, what fee will PayLoom charge?
reference_answer: Adding money with a credit card has a 2 percent fee. 2 percent of Rs 3,000 is Rs 60.

text: I completed 17 successful payments today. How many more successful payments can I make before midnight?
reference_answer: You can make 20 successful transactions per day. 20 - 17 = 3 more successful transactions are left today.

text: I paid 5 electricity/water bills from my bank account and 3 bills from wallet. Total PayLoom fee kitna hoga?
reference_answer: Bill payments from bank account are free. Wallet bill payments cost Rs 3 each, so 3 x Rs 3 = Rs 9 total fee.

text: My UPI payment failed and money was deducted. It has been 4 working days and no reversal. What now?
reference_answer: A failed payment is reversed automatically within 3 working days. Since 4 working days have passed, raise a dispute in Help > Payments with the transaction ID.

text: If I add Rs 3,500 to wallet using my credit card, kitna fee lagega?
reference_answer: Adding money with a credit card has a 2 percent fee. 2 percent of Rs 3,500 is Rs 70, so the fee is Rs 70.

text: I have full KYC wallet with Rs 1,85,000 balance. Can I add Rs 20,000 more?
reference_answer: No. A full KYC wallet can hold up to Rs 2,00,000. You can add only Rs 2,00,000 - Rs 1,85,000 = Rs 15,000.

text: I got a scratch card 12 days ago but forgot to open it. How many days are left before it expires?
reference_answer: A scratch card expires 15 days after you receive it. 15 - 12 = 3 days are left.

text: I want to do mobile recharges of Rs 80, Rs 100, Rs 101 and Rs 250. What is the total platform fee?
reference_answer: Recharges up to Rs 100 are free. The Rs 101 and Rs 250 recharges each have a Rs 2 fee, so the total fee is Rs 4.

text: I did 18 successful payments and 2 failed payments today. Can I still do more payments?
reference_answer: Yes. The limit is 20 successful transactions per day, so 20 - 18 = 2 successful transactions are still left.

text: I want one transaction statement covering 18 months. Is that possible in one download?
reference_answer: No. A statement download can cover up to 12 months. 18 months is 6 months more than the allowed period.

text: Today I have made 17 successful payments on PayLoom. How many more successful UPI payments can I do before midnight?
reference_answer: You can make up to 20 successful transactions per day. 20 - 17 = 3, so you have 3 successful transactions left before midnight.

text: I have already got rewards for 8 referrals this calendar month. If 5 more friends complete eligible first payments, how many of those can give me rewards and how much will I earn?
reference_answer: You can earn rewards for up to 10 referrals per calendar month. 10 - 8 = 2 more referrals can give rewards. You earn 2 x Rs 100 = Rs 200.

text: My basic wallet balance is Rs 7,600. What is the maximum I can add right now without upgrading KYC?
reference_answer: A basic wallet can hold up to Rs 10,000. Rs 10,000 - Rs 7,600 = Rs 2,400, so you can add up to Rs 2,400.

text: Payment is pending, Rs 4,200 deducted, and 26 hours have passed. Should I pay again?
reference_answer: Do not pay again. A pending payment should complete or reverse within 24 hours, and 26 hours have passed, so raise a dispute in Help > Payments.

text: This month 13 friends joined with my referral and each made first payment of Rs 100 within 30 days. How much reward do I get?
reference_answer: Rewards are paid for up to 10 referrals per calendar month. You get 10 x Rs 100 = Rs 1,000.

text: Merchant approved my refund 9 working days back and I still did not get it. Am I eligible to raise a dispute now?
reference_answer: Yes. You should raise a dispute if more than 7 working days have passed since merchant approval. 9 working days is 2 working days over that limit.

text: A merchant charged me twice for the same order, and it has been 2 working days. Should I raise a dispute already?
reference_answer: Not yet. A duplicate charge is normally reversed within 3 working days. Since only 2 working days have passed, wait 1 more working day.

text: I paid 4 electricity bills from wallet. What total convenience fee will PayLoom charge?
reference_answer: Wallet bill payments add a convenience fee of Rs 3 per bill. 4 x Rs 3 = Rs 12 total fee.

text: Merchant approved my refund 6 working days ago. Should I raise a dispute now or wait?
reference_answer: Wait for now. A merchant refund reaches your bank account in 5 to 7 working days, so it is still within the allowed time.

text: Naya bank account add kiye 10 hours hue hain. I already sent Rs 3,200 today and want to send Rs 2,500 more. Allowed hai kya?
reference_answer: No. In the first 24 hours after adding a bank account, the limit is Rs 5,000 per day. You have Rs 5,000 - Rs 3,200 = Rs 1,800 left, so Rs 2,500 is above the limit.

text: I already sent Rs 45,000 today. Can I now send Rs 55,000 to one person in a single UPI payment?
reference_answer: Your daily remaining limit is Rs 55,000 because Rs 1,00,000 - Rs 45,000 = Rs 55,000. But one transaction can be only up to Rs 50,000, so you cannot send Rs 55,000 in a single payment. Split it within the daily limit.

text: Cashback for my payment is not in wallet yet. It has been 36 hours. How much longer can it take as per policy?
reference_answer: Cashback is credited within 48 hours of the payment. 48 - 36 = 12 hours may still be left.

text: Payment pending hai aur amount deduct ho gaya. 26 hours ho gaye. Kya wait karu ya dispute karu?
reference_answer: A pending payment is completed or reversed within 24 hours. Since 26 hours have passed, it is 2 hours over the limit. Raise a dispute in Help > Payments.

text: My friend joined from my referral and made first payment of Rs 90 within 30 days. Do we get Rs 100 each?
reference_answer: No. The first payment must be at least Rs 100. Rs 90 is Rs 10 short, so the referral reward condition is not met.

text: My payment was successful but receiver says no money. It has been 3 working days. What now?
reference_answer: Share the UTR number with the receiver so they can check with their bank. Since more than 2 working days have passed, raise a dispute as well.

text: QR bill was Rs 720 but I paid Rs 1,000 by mistake. How much extra should I ask the merchant to refund?
reference_answer: You overpaid by Rs 1,000 - Rs 720 = Rs 280. Ask the merchant to refund Rs 280; if they do not respond within 7 days, raise a dispute in Help > Payments.

text: It is 12 April and I need the annual statement for tax filing. How many days until PayLoom says it will be available?
reference_answer: The annual statement is available from 15 April. From 12 April to 15 April is 3 days.

text: I am looking for a payment from 30 months ago in app history. Should it be visible?
reference_answer: No. The app shows the last 24 months of transactions. A 30-month-old payment is 6 months older than that limit.

text: Aaj maine Rs 60,000 bhej diye. Ab Rs 45,000 ka payment karna hai, possible hai kya?
reference_answer: No. Your remaining daily limit is Rs 1,00,000 - Rs 60,000 = Rs 40,000, so Rs 45,000 cannot be sent today.

text: I have already sent Rs 35,000 and Rs 40,000 today. Can I send another Rs 25,000 now?
reference_answer: Yes. You have sent Rs 75,000 so far, and Rs 1,00,000 - Rs 75,000 = Rs 25,000 is still available today.

text: I sent money to the wrong person 5 days ago. How many days are left to file the Wrong Transfer complaint within PayLoom policy?
reference_answer: You must raise a Wrong Transfer complaint within 7 days. 7 - 5 = 2 days are left. Also contact your bank.

text: I did mobile recharges of Rs 99, Rs 150 and Rs 249. What platform fee total should I expect?
reference_answer: Recharges up to Rs 100 are free, so Rs 99 has no fee. The Rs 150 and Rs 249 recharges are above Rs 100, so each has Rs 2 fee. Total fee is Rs 4.

text: I added my bank account 10 hours ago. I already sent Rs 3,200. Can I send Rs 2,000 more now?
reference_answer: No. During the first 24 hours, the new user limit is Rs 5,000 per day. Rs 5,000 - Rs 3,200 = Rs 1,800 is left, so Rs 2,000 is above the remaining limit.

text: I am a new user and added bank 26 hours back. Today I sent Rs 70,000. How much more can I send today?
reference_answer: After 24 hours, the normal daily limit applies. Rs 1,00,000 - Rs 70,000 = Rs 30,000 more can be sent today.

text: Full KYC wallet me Rs 1,96,000 hai. Can I keep adding Rs 6,000 more?
reference_answer: No. With full KYC, the wallet can hold up to Rs 2,00,000. You can add only Rs 2,00,000 - Rs 1,96,000 = Rs 4,000.

text: My merchant refund was approved 9 working days ago and still not credited. What should I do?
reference_answer: Raise a dispute in Help > Payments. More than 7 working days have passed, so include the refund reference number from the merchant.

text: A merchant charged me twice, Rs 899 and Rs 899, for the same order. How much should be reversed and when do I complain?
reference_answer: The duplicate extra charge is Rs 899. It is normally reversed within 3 working days; if not reversed after 3 working days, raise a dispute with both transaction IDs.

text: My UPI payment failed, Rs 2,500 was deducted, and it has been 2 working days. Should I file dispute already?
reference_answer: Not yet. A failed payment is reversed automatically within 3 working days, so wait until 3 working days are over.

text: Need to pay Rs 85,000 to my landlord in one go. I have not sent anything today. Will one UPI payment work?
reference_answer: No, one transaction can be only up to Rs 50,000. You can split Rs 85,000 into more than one payment, as it is within the Rs 1,00,000 daily limit.

text: My basic wallet balance is Rs 8,500. Can I add Rs 2,000 more to it?
reference_answer: No. A basic wallet can hold up to Rs 10,000. You can add only Rs 10,000 - Rs 8,500 = Rs 1,500.

text: I referred 12 friends this month. How many rewards can I get, what is the reward amount, and my scratch card came 10 days ago when will it expire?
reference_answer: You can earn rewards for up to 10 referrals per calendar month, so only 10 of the 12 can qualify this month. For each qualifying referral, you and your friend get Rs 100 when the friend completes a first payment of at least Rs 100 within 30 days of joining. A scratch card expires 15 days after you receive it, so one received 10 days ago has 5 days left.

text: I paid yesterday and expecting cashback, but another payment failed and got reversed. Will cashback come for both and when?
reference_answer: Cashback is credited to your wallet within 48 hours of the payment. Cashback does not apply to failed or reversed payments, so it will not come for the failed payment. If the failed payment money was deducted, it is reversed automatically within 3 working days.

text: I need my transaction statement for last 10 months and also annual statement for tax filing. How far back can I see history?
reference_answer: For the last 10 months, go to Profile > Statements, choose the period and tap Download; the PDF is also sent to your registered email. The annual statement is under Profile > Statements > Annual from 15 April. The app shows the last 24 months of transactions.

text: My UPI payment failed but Rs 2400 got debited 4 working days ago. Also I forgot my UPI PIN, how do I reset it?
reference_answer: A failed payment is reversed automatically within 3 working days, so after 4 working days you should raise a dispute in Help > Payments with the transaction ID. To reset your UPI PIN, tap Forgot UPI PIN, enter the last 6 digits and expiry date of your debit card, enter the bank OTP, and set a new PIN.

text: I scanned a shop QR and paid Rs 2,500 instead of Rs 250. The shop is not replying for 8 days. Is this a fraud report or some other complaint?
reference_answer: For paying more than the bill amount by mistake in a QR payment, ask the merchant to refund the extra amount because a completed payment cannot be changed. Since the merchant has not responded within 7 days, raise a dispute in Help > Payments. If you think you were cheated in a fraud payment, also use Help > Report fraud and contact your bank immediately.

text: Are PayLoom transfers to friends free? Also tell me charges for a Rs 150 mobile recharge and paying gas bill from wallet.
reference_answer: Sending money to friends and family from your bank account is free. A Rs 150 mobile recharge is above Rs 100, so the platform fee is Rs 2. Paying a bill from the wallet adds a convenience fee of Rs 3 per bill.

text: Need my payment records: last 18 months, plus FY annual statement for tax. Where can I download, and what if I need older than 24 months?
reference_answer: For statements, go to Profile > Statements, choose the period up to 12 months and tap Download; the PDF is also emailed. The annual statement for the financial year is under Profile > Statements > Annual from 15 April. The app shows only the last 24 months of transactions, so older transactions are not shown in the app.

text: I added a second bank account but I want it as default, and I also need to set UPI PIN for it first time. Steps?
reference_answer: To set the new account as default, go to Settings > Bank accounts, open that account and tap Set as default. To set its UPI PIN, tap Set UPI PIN, enter your debit card's last 6 digits and expiry date, enter the bank OTP, and create a 4 or 6 digit PIN.

text: My UPI PIN got blocked after I typed it wrong 3 times, but I also do not remember the PIN now. Should I wait or reset it?
reference_answer: After 3 wrong attempts, the PIN is blocked for 24 hours. You can wait 24 hours, or reset it right away with Forgot UPI PIN. For reset, enter the last 6 digits and expiry date of your debit card, the bank OTP, and set a new PIN.

text: Merchant says refund was approved 6 working days ago, and another refund was approved 9 working days ago but no money. What should I do for both?
reference_answer: After merchant approval, a refund reaches your bank account in 5 to 7 working days. The 6-working-day refund is still within the normal window. For the 9-working-day refund, raise a dispute in Help > Payments with the refund reference number from the merchant.

text: A store charged me twice for same order today. I want proof for both payments also. What is the reversal time and how do I get receipts?
reference_answer: A duplicate charge for the same order is normally reversed automatically within 3 working days. If the extra amount is not reversed after 3 working days, raise a dispute with both transaction IDs. For receipts, open each transaction in History and tap Share receipt to get a PDF or image.

text: Wallet me kitna paisa rakh sakta hu? Mine is basic now, and I want full KYC plus move wallet money back to bank.
reference_answer: A basic wallet can hold up to Rs 10,000, and with full KYC it can hold up to Rs 2,00,000. To upgrade, go to Wallet > Upgrade KYC and complete video verification with Aadhaar and PAN; it is usually approved within 24 hours. To move money to bank, go to Wallet > Send to bank; it arrives within 30 minutes and has no fee.

text: One payment failed yesterday and money was deducted, another payment was declined today but no debit happened. What are the next steps for both?
reference_answer: For the failed payment with money deducted, it is reversed automatically to your bank account within 3 working days. If it is not back after 3 working days, raise a dispute in Help > Payments with the transaction ID. For the declined payment with no deduction, check your balance, limit and UPI PIN and try again; if it keeps failing, contact your bank.

text: My payment got declined but balance was not deducted. I am also a new user and can send only small amount, why?
reference_answer: A declined payment means your bank refused it, so no money leaves your account. Check your balance, limit and UPI PIN, and try again; if it keeps failing, contact your bank. New users can send up to Rs 5,000 per day during the first 24 hours after adding a bank account.

text: I already made 19 successful payments today totaling Rs 96,000. Can I do two more payments of Rs 2,000 each before midnight?
reference_answer: No. You have only one successful transaction left today because the daily count limit is 20. You also have Rs 4,000 left under the Rs 1,00,000 daily amount limit, so only one more payment up to Rs 4,000 can be made before midnight.

text: I sent money to the wrong UPI ID yesterday, and now that person sent me a collect request asking for PIN to return it. What should I do?
reference_answer: Decline the collect request; you never need to enter your UPI PIN to receive money, and such a request is a scam. For the wrong transfer, raise a Wrong Transfer complaint in Help > Payments within 7 days and contact your bank. PayLoom will ask the receiver's bank to request the money back.

text: I referred 12 friends this month. 9 already made Rs 100 payments, 1 made Rs 50, and 2 have not paid yet. How many referral rewards can I get now?
reference_answer: You earn only when a friend completes a first payment of at least Rs 100 within 30 days of joining. Right now 9 friends qualify, so you and those friends get Rs 100 each. The monthly reward cap is 10 referrals, so only one more qualifying referral can earn this month.

text: Kal maine Rs 150 ka mobile recharge kiya aur electricity bill wallet se pay kiya. Dono pe charges lagenge kya?
reference_answer: Yes. A mobile recharge above Rs 100 has a Rs 2 platform fee, and paying a bill from the wallet adds a Rs 3 convenience fee. So the fees are Rs 2 for the recharge and Rs 3 for the bill.

text: If I add Rs 5,000 to wallet using credit card, what fee applies? Also how can I add wallet money from my bank instead?
reference_answer: Adding money to the wallet with a credit card has a 2 percent fee. For Rs 5,000, 2 percent is Rs 100. To add money from your bank account, go to Wallet > Add money, enter the amount and pay using your UPI PIN; adding from a bank account is free.

text: Phone chori ho gaya. I had app lock disabled. What can I do now to stop PayLoom use and what should I enable next time?
reference_answer: From another phone, log in with your number and tap Deregister old device. Also call your bank to block UPI on your account and your SIM provider to block the SIM. Next time, you can enable Settings > Security > App lock and choose fingerprint, face or a screen PIN.

text: Payment pending hai aur paisa cut ho gaya 2 hours pehle. Should I pay again, and can I send Rs 80000 in one shot if I need to retry later?
reference_answer: Do not pay again while it is pending. A pending payment is completed or reversed within 24 hours; if it is still pending after 24 hours, raise a dispute in Help > Payments. One transaction can be up to Rs 50,000, so Rs 80,000 must be split into more than one payment within your daily limit.

text: I want HDFC to be default but also remove my old ICICI account. There is one pending payment on ICICI. What should I do?
reference_answer: To make HDFC default, go to Settings > Bank accounts, open HDFC and tap Set as default. To remove ICICI, go to Settings > Bank accounts, open it and tap Remove. Finish any pending payments first; removing only unlinks the account from the app and does not close the bank account.

text: My rent payment is pending and amount debited since 3 hours. Another payment shows success but receiver says not received. Should I pay again?
reference_answer: Do not pay again for the pending payment. A pending payment is either completed or reversed within 24 hours; if it is still pending after 24 hours, raise a dispute in Help > Payments. For the successful payment, share the UTR with the receiver and raise a dispute if it is not credited within 2 working days.

text: I paid Rs 1200 on a shop QR but bill was Rs 1000 only. Also is there any extra fee if I pay my electricity bill from wallet?
reference_answer: Ask the merchant to refund the extra Rs 200, because a completed payment cannot be changed. If the merchant does not respond within 7 days, raise a dispute in Help > Payments. Bill payments from the wallet have a convenience fee of Rs 3 per bill.

text: Merchant approved my refund today. How long will it take, and if it still doesnt come what reference should I use for dispute?
reference_answer: After the merchant approves the refund, it reaches your bank account in 5 to 7 working days. If more than 7 working days pass and you still have not received it, raise a dispute in Help > Payments with the refund reference number from the merchant.

text: How do I add Rs 5000 to wallet? If I use credit card is there a fee, and later can I send it back to bank free?
reference_answer: Go to Wallet > Add money, enter Rs 5000 and pay from your bank account using your UPI PIN. Adding money with a credit card has a 2 percent fee, while adding from a bank account is free. You can send wallet money to bank from Wallet > Send to bank, and there is no fee.

text: I think I got cheated in a payment and I also lost the phone used for PayLoom. Where to report fraud and how to stop access?
reference_answer: Open Help > Report fraud, available 24x7, and share the transaction ID. Also contact your bank immediately so it can try to hold the money. From another phone, log in with your number and tap Deregister old device, and call your bank to block UPI and your SIM provider to block the SIM.

text: I have Rs 9,500 in basic wallet and want to add Rs 1,000 more. Also how do I make it full KYC and then send wallet money back to my bank?
reference_answer: A basic wallet can hold only up to Rs 10,000, so Rs 9,500 + Rs 1,000 would exceed the limit by Rs 500. To upgrade, go to Wallet > Upgrade KYC and complete video verification with Aadhaar and PAN; approval is usually within 24 hours. To send wallet money to your bank, use Wallet > Send to bank; it arrives within 30 minutes with no fee.

text: I added SBI account in app but no UPI PIN yet. Where to set it, and if I add my HDFC account also what verification is needed?
reference_answer: For the newly added account, tap Set UPI PIN, enter the debit card last 6 digits and expiry date, enter the bank OTP, and create a 4 or 6 digit PIN. To add another bank account, go to Settings > Add bank account, choose the bank and verify by SMS. The mobile number must be the one registered with that bank account.

text: My mobile number changed. Can I just update it in PayLoom, and how do I remove my old bank account from the app?
reference_answer: First update the new number with your bank. Then log in to PayLoom with the new number and verify by SMS to link your accounts again. To remove a bank account, go to Settings > Bank accounts, open the account and tap Remove; finish any pending payments first.

text: What is the max I can pay today: I need to send Rs 1,20,000 in 3 payments and I already did 19 successful payments today.
reference_answer: You can send up to Rs 1,00,000 per day in total, so Rs 1,20,000 is above the daily limit. A single transaction can be up to Rs 50,000, so larger amounts must be split. You can make up to 20 successful transactions per day, and after 19 you have only 1 successful transaction left today.

text: Amazon charged me twice for the same order, and they also approved a separate refund 8 working days ago but I still dont see it. What now?
reference_answer: A duplicate charge for the same order is normally reversed automatically within 3 working days. If the extra amount is not reversed after 3 working days, raise a dispute with both transaction IDs. Since more than 7 working days have passed after the merchant approved the refund, raise a dispute with the refund reference number from the merchant.

text: I changed my phone number and also got a new bank account. How do I get PayLoom working with the new number and add that account?
reference_answer: First update the new number with your bank. Then log in to the app with the new number and verify by SMS to link your accounts again. To add another account, go to Settings > Add bank account, choose your bank and verify by SMS; the number must be registered with that bank account.

text: I lost my phone last night. I had not enabled fingerprint lock in PayLoom; how can I stop app use and how do I enable lock on my new phone?
reference_answer: From another phone, log in with your number and tap Deregister old device. Also call your bank to block UPI on your account and your SIM provider to block the SIM. On the new phone, go to Settings > Security > App lock and choose fingerprint, face or a screen PIN.

text: Unknown aadmi sent me a collect request saying enter UPI PIN to receive Rs 5,000. Should I approve it, and is there any charge to receive/send to friends?
reference_answer: Decline the request. You never need to enter your UPI PIN to receive money, so a request asking for your PIN is a scam; report it in Help > Report fraud. Sending money to friends and family from your bank account is free.

text: My cashback scratch card came 16 days ago and I also made a payment 30 hours ago. When will cashback come, and can I still open that old scratch card?
reference_answer: A scratch card expires 15 days after you receive it, so a 16-day-old card has expired. Cashback from a payment is credited to your wallet within 48 hours. Since it has been 30 hours, it can still arrive within the normal time.

text: The app says my rent payment is successful but my landlord says he did not get it. I also need a receipt PDF for the same payment.
reference_answer: Share the UTR number with your landlord so they can check with their bank. If it is not credited within 2 working days, raise a dispute. For a receipt, open the transaction in History and tap Share receipt to get a PDF or image.

text: I entered wrong UPI PIN 3 times and now it says blocked. Can I change the PIN or reset it immediately?
reference_answer: After 3 wrong PIN attempts, the PIN is blocked for 24 hours. You can wait 24 hours or reset it right away with Forgot UPI PIN using your debit card details and bank OTP. Change UPI PIN requires entering your old PIN first.

text: I sent Rs 30,000 to the wrong UPI ID today. Also I need to send Rs 60,000 to the correct person now. What are my options?
reference_answer: For the wrong transfer, raise a Wrong Transfer complaint in Help > Payments within 7 days and contact your bank; PayLoom cannot reverse a completed payment itself. A single transaction can be up to Rs 50,000, so Rs 60,000 cannot be sent in one payment. Since the daily limit is Rs 1,00,000 and Rs 30,000 is already sent, you have Rs 70,000 left today, so split Rs 60,000 into more than one payment.

text: I added my bank account 10 hours ago. Can I send Rs 8,000 in one shot, or Rs 4,000 now and Rs 4,000 later today?
reference_answer: No, not during the first 24 hours after adding a bank account. New users can send up to Rs 5,000 per day in that period, so Rs 8,000 total today is not allowed. A single transaction can be up to Rs 50,000, but the new user daily limit is lower here.

text: A shop charged me twice for one order yesterday. It has been 1 working day. Should I file a dispute now?
reference_answer: A duplicate charge for the same order is normally reversed within 3 working days. Since only 1 working day has passed, wait up to 2 more working days. If the extra amount is not reversed after 3 working days, raise a dispute with both transaction IDs.

text: Successful payment, receiver still says not credited after 3 working days. What should I do now?
reference_answer: Raise a dispute now. The policy says to raise a dispute if it is not credited within 2 working days, and 3 working days is beyond that.

text: My UPI payment failed but the amount got debited. It has been 2 working days. Should I raise a dispute now?
reference_answer: Not yet. Failed payments are reversed automatically within 3 working days, and only 2 working days have passed.

text: Merchant approved my refund 5 working days ago, but paisa abhi tak account me nahi aaya. Should I raise a dispute?
reference_answer: A merchant refund reaches your bank account in 5 to 7 working days after approval. Since only 5 working days have passed, wait up to 2 more working days. Raise a dispute only if more than 7 working days have passed.

text: QR payment me bill se zyada pay ho gaya. Merchant 8 days se reply nahi kar raha. What should I do?
reference_answer: Raise a dispute in Help > Payments. The merchant has not responded within 7 days, and 8 days have passed.

text: I used Wallet > Send to bank 25 minutes ago and the money has not arrived yet. Is it delayed?
reference_answer: Not yet. Wallet to bank transfers arrive within 30 minutes. Since 25 minutes have passed, wait up to 5 more minutes; there is no fee.

text: My refund was approved by the merchant 8 working days ago and I still have not received it. What now?
reference_answer: Raise a dispute in Help > Payments with the refund reference number from the merchant. More than 7 working days have passed since approval.

text: Cashback for my successful payment has not come after 36 hours. Is it late?
reference_answer: Not yet. Cashback is credited to your wallet within 48 hours of the payment, and 36 hours is still within that time.

text: I added my bank account 20 hours ago and PayLoom lets me send only small amount. Why?
reference_answer: New users can send up to Rs 5,000 per day during the first 24 hours after adding a bank account. Since only 20 hours have passed, the first-day limit still applies.

text: I paid Rs. 500 extra by QR at a store. The merchant has not replied for 6 days. Can PayLoom reverse it now?
reference_answer: PayLoom cannot change a completed payment. Ask the merchant to refund the extra amount. Since only 6 days have passed, raise a dispute only if the merchant does not respond within 7 days.

text: Wrong person ko payment exactly 7 days pehle ho gaya tha. Can I still raise Wrong Transfer complaint today?
reference_answer: Yes, raise it now. The policy says to raise a Wrong Transfer complaint within 7 days and contact your bank. PayLoom cannot reverse the completed payment itself.

text: Same merchant order got charged twice and the extra amount is not back after 4 working days. Please help.
reference_answer: Raise a dispute with both transaction IDs. Duplicate charges are normally reversed within 3 working days, and 4 working days is beyond that.

text: I was double charged for the same order and the extra debit is not back even after 4 working days. What should I do?
reference_answer: Raise a dispute with both transaction IDs. A duplicate charge is normally reversed within 3 working days. Since 4 working days have passed, it is beyond the reversal time.

text: Mera scratch card 16 din purana hai, ab open karu to chalega kya?
reference_answer: No. A scratch card expires 15 days after you receive it. At 16 days, it has already expired.

text: My cashback for a successful payment is still missing after 50 hours. Is this still within normal time?
reference_answer: No. The policy says cashback is credited within 48 hours. Since 50 hours have passed, it is beyond the stated time, unless the payment failed or was reversed.

text: Transaction shows successful but my friend says he did not get the money. It has been 1 working day. What should I tell him?
reference_answer: Share the UTR number with the receiver so they can check with their bank. Since only 1 working day has passed, wait until 2 working days before raising a dispute.

text: I paid more than the bill amount on a QR payment and the merchant has ignored me for 8 days. What is the next step?
reference_answer: Raise a dispute in Help > Payments. The policy says to do this if the merchant does not respond within 7 days. Since 8 days have passed, the 7-day wait is over.

text: My UPI PIN was blocked yesterday, about 26 hours ago. Do I still need to wait?
reference_answer: No. The block lasts 24 hours after 3 wrong PIN attempts. Since 26 hours have passed, the 24-hour block period is over.

text: I completed Wallet full KYC video verification 10 hours ago. It still shows pending, normal hai kya?
reference_answer: Yes, it can still be normal. Wallet full KYC is usually approved within 24 hours. Since only 10 hours have passed, wait longer.

text: I received a PayLoom scratch card 14 days back and forgot to open it. Can I still scratch it today?
reference_answer: Yes. A scratch card expires 15 days after you receive it. At 14 days, it has 1 day left.

text: My friend joined from my referral and made his first payment of Rs. 100 after 29 days. Will referral reward be valid?
reference_answer: Yes. The reward applies if the friend completes a first payment of at least Rs. 100 within 30 days of joining. Since the payment was after 29 days, it is within the limit.

text: I used Wallet > Send to bank 20 minutes ago. Money has not reached bank yet. Should I worry?
reference_answer: Wait for now. Wallet to bank transfers arrive within 30 minutes, and only 20 minutes have passed.

text: I sent money to the wrong UPI ID by mistake 5 days ago. Can PayLoom get it back?
reference_answer: PayLoom cannot reverse a completed payment itself. Since 5 days is within 7 days, raise a Wrong Transfer complaint in Help > Payments and contact your bank.

text: Mera payment pending hai aur paisa deduct ho gaya, 9 hours ho chuke hain. Should I pay again?
reference_answer: Do not pay again. A pending payment is completed or reversed within 24 hours, and 9 hours is still inside that window.

text: Merchant approved my refund 3 working days ago. It is not in my bank yet, is that normal?
reference_answer: Yes, keep waiting. After merchant approval, the refund reaches your bank account in 5 to 7 working days, and only 3 working days have passed.

text: I paid a shopkeeper extra by QR and asked him to refund. He has not replied for 6 days. Can I raise dispute?
reference_answer: Ask the merchant to refund the extra amount and wait a little longer. The policy says to raise a dispute if the merchant does not respond within 7 days, and only 6 days have passed.

text: My referred friend made the first Rs. 100 payment 31 days after joining. Do we still get Rs. 100 each?
reference_answer: No. The first payment of at least Rs. 100 must be completed within 30 days of joining. At 31 days, it is outside the policy window.

text: I am a new user and added my bank account 25 hours ago. Will the Rs. 5,000 first day limit still apply?
reference_answer: No. The new user limit applies only during the first 24 hours after adding a bank account. Since 25 hours have passed, the normal daily limit applies.

text: Payment failed and money was cut from my account 4 working days ago. Refund abhi tak nahi aaya, what to do?
reference_answer: Raise a dispute in Help > Payments with the transaction ID. The policy says failed payments should reverse within 3 working days, and 4 working days is beyond that.

text: I entered wrong UPI PIN 3 times and it got blocked 12 hours ago. Can I use the same PIN now?
reference_answer: After 3 wrong PIN attempts, the PIN is blocked for 24 hours. Since only 12 hours have passed, wait 12 more hours. You can also reset it right away using Forgot UPI PIN.

text: I paid the wrong person 8 days back. Can I still use the wrong transfer option?
reference_answer: The policy says to raise a Wrong Transfer complaint within 7 days and contact your bank. Since 8 days have passed, it is beyond the stated PayLoom complaint window.

text: My payment is still pending after 26 hours and the amount was debited. What is the next step?
reference_answer: Raise a dispute in Help > Payments. The pending payment window is 24 hours, and 26 hours has already passed.

text: I got a cashback offer on a payment 36 hours ago, but wallet me abhi tak cashback nahi aaya. Should I wait or complain now?
reference_answer: Cashback is credited to your wallet within 48 hours of the payment. Since only 36 hours have passed, wait up to 12 more hours. Cashback does not apply to failed or reversed payments.

text: My UPI PIN got blocked after wrong attempts 6 hours ago. When can I try again?
reference_answer: After 3 wrong attempts, the PIN is blocked for 24 hours. Since 6 hours have passed, you can wait 18 more hours or reset it right away with Forgot UPI PIN.

text: I added a new bank account 30 hours ago. Is the Rs 5,000 new user cap still supposed to apply?
reference_answer: No. The Rs 5,000 new user limit applies only for the first 24 hours after adding a bank account, and 30 hours have passed.

text: I added my first bank account 23 hours ago and PayLoom is still allowing only a small amount. Why?
reference_answer: New users can send up to Rs. 5,000 per day during the first 24 hours after adding a bank account. Since 23 hours have passed, the first-day limit still applies for 1 more hour.

text: My refund was approved by the merchant 8 working days ago and I have the refund reference number. What now?
reference_answer: Raise a dispute in Help > Payments with the refund reference number. The policy says to do this if more than 7 working days have passed since the merchant approved the refund. Here, 8 working days have passed.

text: I got charged twice for the same order yesterday, so 1 working day ago. Should I dispute now?
reference_answer: Wait for now. A duplicate charge for the same order is normally reversed automatically within 3 working days, and only 1 working day has passed.

text: I entered wrong UPI PIN 3 times and it was blocked 25 hours ago. Can I use it now?
reference_answer: Yes, the 24 hour block period has passed. You can use it again, or reset it with Forgot UPI PIN if needed.

text: I sent money to the wrong UPI ID 2 days ago by mistake. Is it too late to complain?
reference_answer: It is not too late under the policy. Raise a Wrong Transfer complaint in Help > Payments within 7 days and contact your bank. PayLoom cannot reverse a completed payment itself, but it will ask the receiver's bank to request the money back.
